t2.title: Social media platforms be regulated by governments
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Should social media platforms be regulated by governments?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
The Future of Television: Is Traditional TV Dying?

Streaming services have fundamentally changed how we consume entertainment. But has traditional television become obsolete?

Undeniably, streaming offers significant advantages. On-demand content, no advertisements, and personalized recommendations have made viewers less tolerant of scheduled programming. Younger generations, in particular, rarely watch linear TV.

However, traditional television still serves important functions. Live events – sports, news, and award shows – remain the domain of broadcast TV. These shared viewing experiences create cultural moments that streaming cannot replicate.

Moreover, not everyone has reliable internet access. In many regions, traditional TV remains the primary entertainment source.

Interestingly, we're seeing convergence rather than replacement. Many TV providers now offer hybrid services combining live broadcasting with streaming features.

Ultimately, traditional TV won't disappear entirely, but its role will certainly diminish as technology evolves.

t2.sampleB1:
Dear StreamMax Customer Team,

Thank you for asking about my experience. I think the content library is pretty good. There are lots of movies and TV shows to choose from. The recommendation system is okay, but it's not always right. Sometimes it suggests things I don't like.

The interface is mostly user-friendly. It's easy to find what I want. However, I think it could be faster. Sometimes it takes a long time to load.

One feature that would improve my experience is offline downloads. It would be great if I could download movies and watch them when I don't have internet access. Also, maybe more subtitles for different languages.

Thanks,
Akmal Yusupov
t2.sampleB2:
Great question — this one really gets people talking!

Personally, I think governments do need to step in, at least to some degree. Social media platforms have become so powerful that leaving them to police themselves simply isn't working. We've all seen how quickly fake news and harmful content can spread, and the companies behind these platforms often turn a blind eye because outrage keeps users scrolling. Sensible rules around misinformation, data privacy and protecting children would go a long way. After all, when a handful of companies can shape public opinion overnight, a little oversight seems only fair.

That said, I do understand why people worry about regulation. There's a fine line between keeping users safe and cracking down on free speech, and no one wants politicians deciding what we can and can't say online.

For me, the answer lies somewhere in the middle: clear, transparent rules that hold companies accountable without silencing ordinary people. Independent watchdogs, rather than governments themselves, should oversee it.

What do you all think? Should platforms be forced to comply, or would that do more harm than good? I'd love to hear your thoughts!
t2.uzSample:
Televideniyening kelajagi: An'anaviy televideniye o'lyaptimi?

Oqimli xizmatlar bizning ko'ngilochar mahsulotlarni iste'mol qilish usulimizni tubdan o'zgartirdi. Ammo an'anaviy televideniye eskirganmi?

Shubhasiz, oqim xizmatlari sezilarli afzalliklarni taqdim etadi. Talab bo'yicha kontent, reklamalarning yo'qligi va shaxsiy tavsiyalar tomoshabinlarni rejalashtirilgan dasturlarga nisbatan kamroq tolerant qilib qo'ydi. Ayniqsa, yosh avlod vakillari chiziqli televideniyeni kamdan-kam hollarda tomosha qilishadi.

Biroq, an'anaviy televideniye hali ham muhim vazifalarni bajaradi. Jonli tadbirlar – sport, yangiliklar va mukofotlar shoulari – hali ham translyatsiya televideniyesining domeni bo'lib qolmoqda. Ushbu umumiy tomosha tajribalari oqim xizmatlari takrorlay olmaydigan madaniy lahzalarni yaratadi.

Bundan tashqari, hamma ham ishonchli internetga ega emas. Ko'pgina mintaqalarda an'anaviy televideniye asosiy ko'ngilochar manba bo'lib qolmoqda.

Qizig'i shundaki, biz almashtirishdan ko'ra konvergentsiyani ko'rmoqdamiz. Ko'pgina TV provayderlari endi jonli translyatsiyani oqim xususiyatlari bilan birlashtirgan gibrid xizmatlarni taklif qilmoqda.

Oxir oqibat, an'anaviy televideniye butunlay yo'q bo'lib ketmaydi, lekin texnologiya rivojlanishi bilan uning roli albatta kamayadi.

t2.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli StreamMax mijozlar jamoasi,

Tajribam haqida so'raganingiz uchun rahmat. Menimcha, kontent kutubxonasi juda yaxshi. Tanlash uchun ko'plab filmlar va teleshoular mavjud. Tavsiya tizimi yaxshi, lekin har doim ham to'g'ri emas. Ba'zan menga yoqmaydigan narsalarni taklif qiladi.

Interfeys asosan foydalanuvchilar uchun qulay. Menga kerak bo'lgan narsani topish oson. Biroq, menimcha, u tezroq bo'lishi mumkin. Ba'zan yuklash uchun uzoq vaqt ketadi.

Mening tajribamni yaxshilaydigan bir xususiyat - bu oflayn yuklab olishlar. Agar men filmlarni yuklab olsam va internetga ulanishim bo'lmaganda ularni tomosha qilsam, juda yaxshi bo'lardi. Shuningdek, turli tillar uchun ko'proq subtitrlar bo'lishi mumkin.

Rahmat,
Akmal Yusupov
t2.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli StreamMax mijozlar jamoasi,

StreamMax bilan dastlabki tajribam yuzasidan murojaat qilganingiz uchun rahmat. Umuman olganda, men nisbatan qoniqdim, lekin yaxshilanishi kerak bo'lgan sohalar aniq.

Kontent kutubxonasi keng, bu katta plyus. Biroq, tavsiya tizimi yanada takomillashtirilishi mumkin. U vaqti-vaqti bilan tegishli kontentni taklif qilsa-da, ko'pincha mashhur nomlarga e'tibor qaratadi va ilgari yoqtirgan niche janrlarini e'tibordan chetda qoldiradi. Ko'rish tarixi va reytinglarni hisobga oladigan yanada murakkab algoritm foydali bo'ladi.

Interfeys odatda intuitiv, garchi profillar o'rtasida harakatlanish va kuzatuv ro'yxatlarini boshqarish soddalashtirilishi mumkin. Yana ham ko'zga tashlanadigan qidiruv funksiyasi ham qadrlanadi.

Xususiyatlar nuqtai nazaridan, men turli qurilmalarda mening taraqqiyotimni aniq aks ettiradigan "tomosha qilishni davom etish" bo'limini joriy etishni taklif qilaman. Bundan tashqari, maxsus pleylistlar yaratish va ularni boshqa foydalanuvchilar bilan baham ko'rish imkoniyati platformaning ijtimoiy jihatini yaxshilaydi. Nihoyat, subtitrlar variantlarini, shu jumladan moslashtiriladigan shrift o'lchamlari va uslublarini yaxshilash imkoniyatini oshiradi.

Hurmat bilan,
Akmal Yusupov

Ko'rish afzalliklaringizga mos keladimi yoki yo'qmi, bilish uchun ularning bepul sinov davridan foydalanishni qat'iy tavsiya qilaman. To'liq obunaga majbur bo'lishdan oldin uni o'rganishga arziydi.

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the streaming service. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample:
Dear StreamMax Customer Team,

Thank you for inviting my feedback. I am generally pleased with my subscription.

Firstly, the content variety is impressive. The mix of films, series, and documentaries caters to diverse tastes.

However, I have noticed some issues. The buffering during peak hours is frustrating, particularly during weekend evenings. Improving server capacity would greatly enhance the experience.

Additionally, the subtitle options are limited. Adding more languages would benefit international viewers.

Furthermore, a download feature for offline viewing would be extremely useful for commuters like myself.

Thank you for your commitment to improving user experience.

Yours faithfully,
A Satisfied Subscriber

However, I have a few suggestions. Sometimes the streaming stops and it's annoying. I think you should improve the servers. Also, it would be good if you had more subtitles in different languages. That would be helpful for more people.

t12.sampleB2:
Dear StreamMax Customer Team,

Thank you for getting in touch to ask about my experience so far. On the whole, I have been pleasantly surprised by the service. The content library is wonderfully varied, and I appreciate how the recommendation system genuinely picks up on my tastes rather than simply pushing the latest releases. The interface is clean and easy to get to grips with.

That said, there is room for improvement. I have run into frequent buffering during peak hours, which quickly becomes frustrating. Expanding your server capacity would make a real difference. I would also welcome a wider range of subtitle options and, above all, an offline download feature for watching on the move.

Thank you for taking my feedback on board. I look forward to seeing how the platform develops.

Yours faithfully,
Bekzod Aliyev

Hurmat bilan,
